text.p: Braun's Fashions Corp said Nasdaq will remove the Q bankruptcy designation from the company's trading symbol effective Friday following its "successful reorganization and strong current operating performance".
Braun's said this will allow some previously restricted institutional investors to trade the stock.

"The final piece is now in place with Nasdaq acknowledging our successful reorganization," Braun's chairman and chief executive Nicholas Cook said in a statement. "Our operating performance has been outstanding, our cash position is strong and our outlook continues to be very optimistic."
Braun's said same-store sales increased 35 percent for March, the first month in its new fiscal year.
